Class MoveValidator

java.lang.Object
chess.service.MoveValidator
public class MoveValidator extends Object
Decides whether a move is legal and, if not, explains why.

This class is the Phase 2 answer to duplicated logic. In Phase 1, Game.tryMove repeated the checks in Piece.canMoveTo so it could produce error messages, and the two copies could drift apart. Now the piece-level sequence lives only in Piece.checkMove(Position, Board), and this class is the only place that adds the rules needing the whole position: whose piece it is, castling out of or through check, and king safety. Game.tryMove(Position, Position), the legal-move hints, the checkmate test, and the computer opponent all call the same findProblem(Board, PieceColor, Move) method, so they always agree.

The class has no state; it reads the board it is given.

  • Method Details

    • findProblem

      public String findProblem(Board board, PieceColor side, Move move)
      Explains why move is illegal for side, or returns null if it is legal.

      Checks, in order: the source square is occupied, the piece belongs to side, the piece-level checks (Piece.checkMove(Position, Board)), castling-specific attack rules, the promotion choice, and finally that the move does not leave side's king in check. The last check plays the move on a copy of the board, so the real board is never touched.

      Parameters:
      board - the current position
      side - the color that is moving
      move - the move to check
      Returns:
      a message for the player, or null if the move is legal

    • isLegal

      public boolean isLegal(Board board, PieceColor side, Move move)
      Checks whether a move is legal for side.
      Parameters:

      side - the color that is moving
      move - the move to check
      Returns:
      true if findProblem(Board, PieceColor, Move) finds nothing wrong

    • legalMovesFrom

      public List<Move> legalMovesFrom(Board board, Position from)
      Lists the legal moves of the piece on from, scanning destinations from rank 8 to rank 1. A move onto the last rank is listed once, promoting to a queen.
      Parameters:
      board - the current position
      from - the square of the piece to examine
      Returns:
      new list of legal moves (empty if the square is empty or the piece is stuck)

    • legalMoves

      public List<Move> legalMoves(Board board, PieceColor side)
      Lists every legal move for one color.
      Parameters:
      board - the current position
      side - the color to move
      Returns:
      new list of legal moves; empty means checkmate or stalemate

    • hasAnyLegalMove

      public boolean hasAnyLegalMove(Board board, PieceColor side)
      Checks whether one color has at least one legal move. Stops at the first one found, which makes it faster than !legalMoves(...).isEmpty().
      Parameters:
      board - the current position
      side - the color to move
      Returns:
      false exactly when side is checkmated or stalemated

    • promotionFor

      private static PieceType promotionFor(Piece piece, Position to)
      Returns the default promotion choice for a move, so generated moves are complete.
      Parameters:
      piece - the moving piece
      to - its destination
      Returns:
      PieceType.QUEEN for a pawn reaching the last rank, otherwise null
